ef98d42090.alt: The finished viking ship at dusk on the playa, shields glowing warm from within and blue light washing the painted wave skirts at its base
ef98d42090.caption: Black Rock City, August 2024. The shields lit from inside; the sea lit from below.

3e393a2071.alt: Sixteen crew members in matching black hoodies posed in front of the ship on the open playa under heavy gray cloud
3e393a2071.caption: The crew, on playa. Most of them had never built anything like this before they showed up.

4fbd4c5edd.alt: The ship's prow at night, a ring of illuminated blue runes above a glowing lantern, with laser beams from the city fanning out behind

0c3c7548b3.alt: The ship seen at distance across the open playa in daylight, dwarfed by the desert, with the Man and the mountains behind it
0c3c7548b3.caption: For scale. Twenty feet of ship, and still a speck.

fadbd88843.alt: The lit ship at night with people aboard, a burst of flame above the deck

4ea3979084.alt: An AI-generated concept rendering of a viking longship resting in a circular depression in desert dunes
4ea3979084.caption: The first image of it that existed, generated in January 2024 to explain the idea to other people. Nobody on the team could draw.

e87851e0d7.alt: A hand holding a translucent panel up against a deep blue sky, sunlight blazing through the material

22d2cefed6.alt: Build day inside a timber-framed shop, half a dozen people working along a run of steel box section while a grinder throws a sheet of sparks
22d2cefed6.caption: April 2024. Build days ran most weekends for eleven months.

7c41386491.alt: The welded steel keel frame clamped up outdoors under a canopy, dozens of C-clamps holding the cross members while the epoxy sets
7c41386491.caption: The steel spine, before any of it looked like a ship.

49bbe7681e.alt: Two deer skulls with full antler racks packed in a cardboard box outdoors
49bbe7681e.caption: Deer skulls donated by my grandfather.

85ba624466.alt: Seven painted round shields propped against the ship's hull in a suburban back yard, each with a different burned and stencilled design
85ba624466.caption: July 2024, a month out. Shields made by Martin Stenflo and Leanne Lopez.

33b5928241.alt: The control electronics laid out on a bench — a green custom circuit board marked FABLE BOUND carrying four ESP32 modules and relay boards, wired to 12-volt supplies through a labeled harness reading PS RAIL, SB UP, SB AFT and SB FORE
33b5928241.caption: The board that ran the ship. Labeled harness, because you cannot debug a pneumatic system in the dark at 2am otherwise.

a44c44525a.alt: The complete ship parked on a path in a Denver park in spring, painted blue wave skirts spread around its base and wooden steps at the center
a44c44525a.caption: April 2025, set up in Denver. It traveled after the burn.

14b17ddc04.alt: A forklift lowering a section of the ship's hull into place on the open playa
14b17ddc04.caption: Setting the hull, Black Rock City.

38110a78b2.alt: A life-size raven sculpture of black feathers and leather perched on a nest lashed to the mast, wings spread, against a blue desert sky

e8503724aa.alt: A raven built from cut black leather gripping the ship's rail with wire talons, the empty playa stretching out behind

8b8e3dd5ba.alt: A tooled leather panel hung on the mast, burned with a raven above a rune compass and a ring of staves

4be4107712.alt: An antlered skull mounted high on the mast at blue hour, uplit from a collar of warm light at its base

eb802f15da.alt: The ship lit at dusk outside an event center, shields glowing cyan and the wave skirts washed blue, people standing on deck
eb802f15da.caption: October 2024. First outing after the playa, at a decompression event.

483d7f863b.alt: The ship on a grass field beneath tall cumulus, shields mounted along the hull and painted waves banked against its sides
483d7f863b.caption: June 2025, Apogaea, Colorado regional burn.
